title: xAI · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 更新日期至 10-15，新增 SpaceXSI Speech to Text API 正式可用，删除旧 xAI 命名。

pairs.key: you can now clone a voice from a short audio clip and use it across the text-to-speech and speech to speech apis
pairs.before: You can now clone a voice from a short audio clip and use it across the Text-to-Speech and Speech to Speech APIs. Create and manage your voice catalog from the xAI console. For more details, check out the Custom Voices docs and our blog post.
pairs.after: You can now clone a voice from a short audio clip and use it across the Text-to-Speech and Speech to Speech APIs. Create and manage your voice catalog from the SpaceXSI console. For more details, check out the Custom Voices docs and our blog post.

added_lines: The SpaceXSI Speech to Text API is now generally available. Transcribe audio to text in 25 languages with batch and streaming modes. For more details, check out the Speech to Text docs.
removed_lines: The xAI Speech to Text API is now generally available. Transcribe audio to text in 25 languages with batch and streaming modes. For more details, check out the Speech to Text docs.
